typography.frame_rule: FRAME RULE — 4:5 carousel still: keep clean negative space in the top 25% with every head and face below it; keep the bottom 15% free of key detail.
rules: One bold headline per slide (max 6 words, 2 lines at 84px), top safe band (y 110–420px), white on a midnight-navy plate, composited as the top layer.
Never place text over a face or head; the frame rule keeps the top band clear.
Small 'Illustrative animation' tag bottom-left on every slide.

plan.caption: Would you leave THIS robot home alone? Figure's 56% comes from Figure's own evaluation, not an independent test. 'Never seen' applies to the homes and objects; the three chores were trained on data collected elsewhere. 1X says NEO works autonomously by default; the remote 1X Expert is scheduled for chores NEO doesn't know. Figure's robot and 1X's NEO are different robots from different companies; the robot in this reel is an illustration of neither. Source: https://www.figure.ai/news/helix-2-5-zero-shot-30-home-generalization. Illustrative animation.
